run_SocialIQA_main: run the SocialIQA dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_SocialIQA_instance: create a SocialIQA dataset instance that loads the social_i_qa HuggingFace dataset for few-shot learning
test_get_choices_and_answer_string: test the get_choices_and_answer_string method to extract answer choices and correct answer from a datapoint
review_map_hf_dataset_to_list: review the map_hf_dataset_to_list method that transforms HuggingFace dataset splits into input-answer text pairs
summarize_load_dataset: summarize the load_dataset method that loads the social_i_qa dataset from HuggingFace
